selected.name: Phoebe Bridgers
selected.description: Phoebe Bridgers is an American singer-songwriter known for her emotive indie rock and folk music.

properties.description: Originally founded in Britain, this footwear brand has become a global cultural symbol known for its iconic air-cushioned boots and shoes. Its identity is inextricably linked to music, art, and counter-culture, appealing to individuals who value durability and authentic self-expression. While maintaining a heritage-focused core, the brand continuously evolves through collaborations and a diverse range of styles. It occupies a premium spot in the market, serving as a staple choice for those seeking footwear that bridges utility and fashion.
properties.short_description: Dr. Martens is a British footwear and clothing brand known for its iconic durable boots and shoes with distinctive yellow stitching.

properties.description: A global leader in the design and manufacture of musical instruments, the brand has been an integral part of musical history since 1946. Its portfolio includes a wide range of electric and acoustic guitars, basses, and amplification systems favored by professionals and hobbyists alike. Known for its heritage and commitment to craftsmanship, the company balances tradition with modern innovation to influence contemporary sound. Its market position is that of a premium, essential tool for artists across diverse genres and skill levels.
properties.short_description: Fender is a leading manufacturer of electric and acoustic guitars, bass guitars, amplifiers, and related musical accessories.

properties.description: Established in 1970, this lifestyle retailer serves a youthful audience with a carefully curated collection of clothing, accessories, and home goods. The brand is known for its eclectic aesthetic that draws from vintage trends, indie music culture, and modern bohemian style. Operating primarily as a brick-and-mortar and e-commerce entity, it functions as a destination for creative young adults looking for self-expression through fashion and living space design. It remains a fixture in urban and university areas, maintaining a balance between accessible, trendy apparel and lifestyle products.
properties.short_description: Urban Outfitters is a lifestyle retailer offering clothing, homeware, and accessories inspired by creativity and cultural trends.

properties.description: An iconic American manufacturer with a history dating back to 1894, specializing in the creation of premium electric and acoustic guitars. The company is recognized for its commitment to high-quality craftsmanship, sound excellence, and historical innovation within the music industry. Serving professional musicians and devoted collectors globally, it remains a pillar of guitar culture and sonic development. Through its extensive catalog and reputable subsidiary brands, it provides essential tools for creative expression across diverse musical genres.
properties.short_description: American manufacturer of iconic electric and acoustic guitars, amplifiers, and musical instruments known for craftsmanship and sound excellence since 1894.

properties.description: Originally founded as a punk magazine in Montreal, the brand has evolved into a massive, multi-platform media entity focused on investigative journalism and cultural reportage. It distinguishes itself by prioritizing authentic, first-hand storytelling and unconventional perspectives that often challenge mainstream narratives. Through a mix of video, text, and digital media, it serves a global audience that values transparency and exploration of the world's most complex sociopolitical issues. The brand holds a unique position as both an established media powerhouse and a voice for the countercultural zeitgeist.
properties.short_description: VICE is a global media brand known for original journalism and content covering diverse cultural, social, and political topics, including its Spanish-language platform VICE en Español.
